description: Checks a URL or host against the OpenPhish public phishing feed (about 300 currently active phishing URLs, updated continuously). Returns whether the exact URL or any URL on the same host is listed, the feed size and up to 5 example URLs. Not listed does not mean safe; the feed is short and changes fast. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: A full http or https URL, or a host name such as example.com (required)

name: security_openphish_feed
